$description: Resizable (platform/components/Resizable), library wave 10, lane A: its component tokens. The edges follow the shell's pane splitter (a wide hit area, a line in the focus ring's color on hover and focus); the size is a size token set per step from data-plx-width and data-plx-height.

resizable-width.$description: Resizable: its width; each size step (data-plx-width) sets it to that size token.

resizable-height.$description: Resizable: its height; each size step (data-plx-height) sets it to that size token.

resizable-min-width.$description: Resizable: the narrowest it goes unless the page sets minWidth.

resizable-max-width.$description: Resizable: the widest it goes unless the page sets maxWidth.

resizable-min-height.$description: Resizable: the shortest it goes unless the page sets minHeight.

resizable-max-height.$description: Resizable: the tallest it goes unless the page sets maxHeight.

resizable-edge-size.$description: Resizable edge: the hit area across the edge (the pane splitter's), half inside the box and half outside.

resizable-edge-line-width.$description: Resizable edge: the line shown on hover and focus (the pane splitter's).

resizable-edge-line-inset.$description: Resizable edge: the line's place in the middle of the hit area.

resizable-edge-hover-line-color.$description: Resizable edge hovered or focused: the line in the focus ring's color (its focus indicator).

resizable-edge-duration.$description: Resizable edge: how fast the line and the size menu appear.

resizable-edge-z-index.$description: Resizable edge: above the box's content.

resizable-corner-size.$description: Resizable (both): the corner the pointer drags in both directions.

resizable-divider-size.$description: Resizable divider: the width of the gap the edge fills; a container sets it on its own element (SplitView: its gap).

resizable-divider-line-color.$description: Resizable divider: the two thin lines along the gutter's sides and its grip's lines (owner, 2026-10-26: the uiwjs look). Forced colors: CanvasText, so the grip stays drawn (issue 560).

resizable-divider-line-width.$description: Resizable divider: the side lines and the grip's lines.

resizable-divider-background.$description: Resizable divider: the gutter between its two lines, at rest.

resizable-divider-hover-background.$description: Resizable divider: the gutter while hovered, focused or dragged (the data grid's selected-row tint).

resizable-divider-grip-gap.$description: Resizable divider: the distance between the grip's three short lines in the middle of the gutter (one grid step).

resizable-divider-active-color.$description: Resizable divider: the side lines and the grip while the divider is focused or dragged.
